title: Yak & Yeti Quality Beverages | Dining | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Yak & Yeti™ Quality Beverages Located in Asia at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park When your thirst is at its peak, hike in for a refreshing beverage like the Yak Attack, emperor margarita or—better yeti—Safari Amber on draft. You can even fuel up for the trek ahead with Chicken Fried Rice, salads, chips, frozen lemonade and soft drinks.View Menu American Bar-Lounge Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required.
